description: World delta snapshots, anchored transactions, command staging, registry/spatial projections and inverse-link validation
state: World=(text, entities with delta histories, events, cursor, position, narrative Story)
cost: Let H be total stored deltas, P their payload bytes, N entities, E events and K inspected link entries. Snapshot replay costs its prefix deltas plus payload cloning and ordered-map operations. apply clones all retained world text/history/story state before dispatch; that cost cannot be omitted. check_links may repeatedly replay referenced histories, so a conservative bound counts O((N+K)*(H+P+log(N+1))) work plus ordered-set operations, not a linear cached-snapshot claim. need_event is O(E); next_free scans IDs. place has 17 admitted recursion levels; ancestors holds at most 65 IDs. run sums executed calls, cloning both accepted and subsequently rejected attempts. External Story work, allocation latency and formatting costs are unmeasured; no wall-clock or asymptotic bound for opaque dependencies is asserted.
forward: Validate anchors, clone world, dispatch commands and gates, commit only on success; scoped children bind the entire source
inverse: Behavior complement excludes rollback violations and inconsistent checked links
Reverse reconstruction retains all histories matching snapshot/role/cursor projections
limitations: Finite tests; parser and Story policy external; arithmetic/allocation premises; private local mutations are not transactional
